reason: The repository is primarily an integration-orchestration plugin for dsh: it installs a bundle manifest that registers a `clawo` ACP subagent provider and routes requests to Claw Orchestrator. Its user-visible modes and documented workflow (single/council/ultraplan/ultrareview) indicate its purpose is coordinating multi-agent execution rather than providing core IDE, UI, or standalone generation logic.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件包，用于在 dsh 中注册 Claw Orchestrator 为 ACP 子代理提供者，并支持按需将任务交给单引擎或多引擎协作流程。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that registers Claw Orchestrator as an ACP subagent provider in dsh, enabling delegation to single-engine or multi-engine collaboration modes for tasks.

capabilities: Registers a DeepSeek Harness subagent provider through a dsh bundle manifest
Delegates prompts to Claw Orchestrator via ACP for single-engine or council execution modes
Supports multi-engine council and review/planning modes that act on repository worktrees
Requires host-installed coding CLIs (for example, claude/codex) to run
